notes.title: The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story Trading Cards
notes.notes: Trading Cards for The Mageseeker are now supported. We wanted to bring these to you all sooner, but ran into some unforeseen circumstances that delayed their release. notes.notes: Freed from the chains of the Mageseeker’s tyranny, play as Sylas and liberate Demacia with the chains that once bound you. The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story is 40% off from Nov 21 - Nov 28.

notes.title: Nominate The Mageseeker for Steam Awards 2023
notes.notes:
Attention all mages! 

This year’s Steam Awards are just around the corner, and nomination season has begun! If you loved playing Sylas, exploring Demacia, and slinging spells in our 2D pixel art style, be sure to nominate The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story for the Outstanding Visual Style category. 

Submit your nominations before the Steam Autumn Sale ends on November 28th, and be ready to cast your ballot when voting begins on December 21st! 

For the true Demacia!

notes.title: Try Out The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story Demo Now!
notes.notes: From Digital Sun, creators of Moonlighter, The Mageseeker is an action RPG in the League of Legends universe. You can now try out the demo, where you play as Sylas, a mage now freed from years in captivity. Wield the chains that once bound you and liberate Demacia from the Mageseekers' tyranny.

notes.title: In-game Progression Update
notes.notes: In our previous patch we sent out a fix to address an issue with progress that caused you to be stuck at 93%, however we heard reports that it was still occurring. Our update today should address this bug, and you will now be able to progress 100% in-game.

notes.title: Steam Summer Sale & Major Patch
notes.notes:
Beginning today, all Riot Forge titles, including The Mageseeker are on Sale for Steam's Summer Sale! Be sure to snag your favorite Riot Forge titles for a discounted price!

In addition to the Steam Summer sale, we have a new patch available today. This patch includes fixes for the 93% bug, the final achievement fix as well as a fix for enemy health bars. Below is the complete list of fixes. 

[list]
[*] Key Post glow color is now set to magic color. Once a Key Post is activated they show as activated for the rest of the run
[*] 93% bug fixed
[*] Polished visuals on Thunderstorm ability
[*] Final Spark frame rainbow effect restored
[*] Big Chest particles are no longer static
[*] Added particles when Sylas leaves Invisibility mode
[*] Integrated a new water shader
[*] Chickens and wheat assets are no longer static, and will move
[*] Added warnings for the Giant's Helm storm attack in Hidden Pass Headquarters
[*] Added new idle breaks to Sylas's idle state when not moving
[*] A red arrow will now appear when dealing damage against an enemy with the same magic type
[*] Improvements made to Thunderbeast's Thunderstorm warning
[*] Text bubble from War Table now appears gold-colored like player objectives
[*] Added idles to all the horses at Great City of Demacia (II)
[*] Improved the bubble for special characters in the Hideout. Now you should be able to see them from a greater distance
[*] Increased text size of bark bubbles on all platforms
[*] For keyboard and mouse, by default, the "A" and "D" keys changed to the left and right arrows for navigating in the tutorial panels
[*] Durand's Defense warning is now a red circle
[*] Boss cutscenes now automatically skip when restarting a fight upon player death
[*] Fixed health bars for Giant's Helm, Garen Fight 2, Sylas's Nightmare, and Shyvana fights
[*] Fixed scale issues with Sylas's Nightmare's Chain Hook
[*] Fixed pixel displacement issues with HUD canvas.
[*] Fixed mana obtain glow overlay from triggering every time Sylas hits an enemy.
[*] Fixed an issue where the Elite Storm Mageseeker's Lightspeed ability would still show particles when invisible
[*] Fixed an issue where number of items required for mission completion is inconsistent with items present in game
[*] Fixed an issue where enemies could teleport outside encounter boundaries
[*] Fixed an issue where player could become stuck in the Pause Menu indefinitely
[*] Fixed an issue with targeting the Dark Hound enemy
[*] Fixed an issue during the Jarvan boss fight where Jarvan would appear duplicated
[*] For keyboard and mouse, by default, the "A" and "D" keys changed to the left and right arrows for navigating in the tutorial panels
[*] For keyboard and mouse, added a Quick Cast option that removes the aim step to allow automatic copying, casting, and using abilities.
[*] Various spelling and text issues fixed
[*] Various UI and HUD issues fixed
[*] Various Map and Objective issues fixed
[/list]

notes.title: The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story FAQ
notes.notes:
[b]What type of game is The Mageseeker?[/b]
The game is an indie 2D Hi-Bit Pixel, action RPG.

[b]Where does this game take place?[/b]
The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story is a 2D Pixel, action RPG in Demacia.

[b]What regions will the game be available in?[/b]
We are aiming to release the game worldwide.

[b]What platforms will the game be on?[/b]
The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story will be available on Playstation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch and PC (Steam, Epic, GOG).

[b]Will the game be available for Mac OS?[/b]
We’re exploring all platforms but as of right now, the game currently isn’t planned to be released on Mac at the same time as console and PC.

[b]Will there be multiplayer? Can I play with my friends?[/b]
The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story is a single player, 2D pixel hack & slash RPG and will not be available to play on multiplayer.

[b]Will there be a tutorial?[/b]
The Mageseeker has tutorials throughout the game. Players will be able to reference these tutorials from the menu at any point. 

[b]What champions are in the game?[/b]
Players will be able to explore Demacia as Sylas, an escaped mage who joins a band of rebels in the deep forest. Check out our website for more details on the supporting cast: Lux, Garen, Morgana, Jarvan IV, and Shyvana.

[b]Why is this a Riot Forge game?[/b]
Riot Forge is a publishing label within Riot Games that complements Riot’s internally developed games. Our focus is to work with experienced studios outside of Riot Games to create bespoke “completable” games set in the League of Legends universe.

[b]How much will the game cost? Is it Free to Play?[/b]
Riot Forge games are not free to play. Riot Forge makes premium completable, narrative driven games, as opposed to “live services” type games, which include free to play games. 

The Mageseeker will be $29.99 for the Standard Edition, $39.99 for the Digital Deluxe, and $169.99 for the Collectors Edition.

[b]Is The Mageseeker available to play on next-gen consoles like PS5 and Xbox Series X|S?[/b]
Yes, The Mageseeker will be available to play on next-gen consoles.

[b]Will there be a mobile version of The Mageseeker? [/b]
Currently, The Mageseeker is not available on mobile. 

[b]Why did Riot Forge pick Digital Sun?[/b]
Digital Sun is a multi-game studio on a mission to create games that are worth playing, and have fun while doing so. Previously, they shipped: Moonlighter, an action RPG with rogue-like elements about Will, an adventurous shopkeeper who secretly dreams of becoming a hero. Digital Sun excels in bringing their games to life through their determined characters and beautiful artwork - the choice to collaborate with them was easy. We’re super excited to be working with them!

[b]How do we know that these partners will treat the IP correctly?[/b]
One of Riot's strengths is the depth we have created within the League of Legends Universe and the Riot Forge team is here to support our developers and ensure they understand all aspects of the world. Our feedback ensures we create authentic League of Legends games together.

notes.title: Reserve Your Spot In The Revolution: Pre-order The Mageseeker
notes.notes:
Join Sylas on his journey to bring justice to Demacia by pre-ordering the indie 2D action RPG, The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story today. This gritty action-packed adventure is available for pre-order on PlayStation 4|5, Xbox One, Xbox Series X/S, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Epic, GOG, Steam).

[previewyoutube=-KHMMMHvDdM;full][/previewyoutube]

The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story is a 2D pixel action RPG developed by Digital Sun, an indie studio best known for their monster-stomping RPG, Moonlighter. Riot Forge and Digital Sun joined forces to bring the mystical story of Sylas, the Unshackled, to life. 

The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story follows Sylas, a Demacian mage, through his journey of revenge and justice as he escapes Demacia, a society obsessed with rooting out magic. After learning Sylas was “afflicted” with magical abilities, his parents persuaded him to turn himself in to the kingdom’s mageseekers.

The mageseekers used Sylas’ abilities to identify and locate other mages. But Sylas began to doubt their mission and take pity on those he helped to condemn. After an incident that left mageseekers dead, Sylas was sentenced to life imprisonment as just a boy. The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story picks up on Sylas’s journey as he escapes the dungeons of Demacia to build his rebellion.

Bring Demacia to its reckoning by pre-ordering today and unshackle the magic when The Mageseeker: A League of Legends Story launches on April 18th.
